facts.label: Ordens e quantidades
facts.sub: Use o verbo base para ordens: Put it on the scale. Pergunte How many + plural e How much + preço: How many stamps? How much is it?

facts.label: Comandos
facts.sub: O imperativo usa o verbo base, sem you: Put it on the scale. Fill in this form. Write the address here. Acrescente please para ser mais educado.

facts.label: Quantos
facts.sub: How many é para coisas que contamos: How many forms do I need? How many days does it take? Depois de many, use o plural.

pages.title: Mito ou fato? · 1/2

items.s: A command uses the base verb.
We say “You fill in this form” as a command.
items.why: We say Fill in this form.

items.s: How many is for countable things.

pages.instruction: Decida e explique com suas palavras.

solo: Aluno responde e justifica; você mostra a pista.
group: Cada aluno decide sozinho, depois compare as respostas e peça uma justificativa.
Corrija pela pista do texto, não só dizendo “certo/errado”.
extra90: Peça que cada aluno invente uma pergunta igual para o colega.
answers: A command uses the base verb. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)
We say “You fill in this form” as a command. → Falso (We say Fill in this form.)
How many is for countable things. → Verdadeiro (Yes: forms, stamps.)

pages.title: A post office · 1/3
paragraphs: It is a busy morning at a post office in Houston. A line of people waits at the counter. Leo holds a big brown box. His friend Jack works at the window. Jack wears a blue shirt. He waves to Leo.
“Hi, Leo! Come in. How can I help you?” says Jack. “I’d like to send this box to Brazil. How much is it?” says Leo. “Put it on the scale, please. It’s two kilos.” says Jack.
